<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$pages = array(
  array('title' => 'À propos', 'slug' => 'a-propos', 'template' => 'page-a-propos.php'),
  array('title' => 'Solutions', 'slug' => 'solutions', 'template' => 'page-solutions.php'),
  array('title' => "Bureau d'études", 'slug' => 'bureau-etudes', 'template' => 'page-bureau-etudes.php'),
);
foreach ($pages as $p) {
  if (get_page_by_path($p['slug'])) { continue; }
  $id = wp_insert_post(array(
    'post_type'   => 'page',
    'post_title'  => $p['title'],
    'post_name'   => $p['slug'],
    'post_status' => 'publish',
  ));
  if ($id && !is_wp_error($id)) {
    update_post_meta($id, '_wp_page_template', $p['template']);
  }
}
